terminal.none: narrative spatial puzzle, no win condition just exploration

scripts.update_view:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState

local desk_items = {}
local bed_items = {}

if sceneState.book_loc == 'desk' then table.insert(desk_items, "Old Journal") end
if sceneState.clock_loc == 'desk' then table.insert(desk_items, "Broken Clock") end
if sceneState.book_loc == 'bed' then table.insert(bed_items, "Old Journal") end
if sceneState.clock_loc == 'bed' then table.insert(bed_items, "Broken Clock") end

sceneState.desk_text = #desk_items > 0 and table.concat(desk_items, ", ") or "(empty)"
sceneState.bed_text = #bed_items > 0 and table.concat(bed_items, ", ") or "(empty)"

if sceneState.book_loc == 'desk' and sceneState.clock_loc == 'desk' then
    sceneState.narrative_1 = "The desk is cluttered now. They used to"
    sceneState.narrative_2 = "stay up late, watching the time pass while"
    sceneState.narrative_3 = "writing. The bed looks so empty."
elseif sceneState.book_loc == 'bed' and sceneState.clock_loc == 'bed' then
    sceneState.narrative_1 = "Everything on the bed. They must have been"
    sceneState.narrative_2 = "too tired to get up, trying to read"
    sceneState.narrative_3 = "but watching the clock instead."
elseif sceneState.book_loc == 'desk' and sceneState.clock_loc == 'bed' then
    sceneState.narrative_1 = "The journal on the desk, the clock on the bed."
    sceneState.narrative_2 = "A normal arrangement. It looks almost like"
    sceneState.narrative_3 = "someone is about to come back."
else
    sceneState.narrative_1 = "The clock on the desk, the journal on the bed."
    sceneState.narrative_2 = "Time marches on, even when you're sleeping."
    sceneState.narrative_3 = "Or trying to."
end
